name: com.useorgx/orgx-mcp
title: OrgX MCP — Organizational Memory for AI Agents
description: Organizational memory and agent orchestration MCP. Remember decisions, artifacts, tasks, and project context across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other agents.

tools.name: orgx_bootstrap
tools.description: Establish OrgX session context, granted scopes, and v2 routing guidance.

tools.name: orgx_search
tools.description: Search OrgX memory and entities; replaces list_entities and query_org_memory for public guidance.

tools.name: orgx_inspect
tools.description: Hydrate one OrgX entity with context; replaces get_task_with_context for public guidance.

tools.name: orgx_recommend
tools.description: Recommend next actions, morning-brief signals, queue priority, pulses, and snapshots.

tools.name: orgx_write
tools.description: Create or update OrgX entities with canonical snake_case fields.

tools.name: orgx_attach
tools.description: Attach durable artifacts and proof to existing OrgX entities.

tools.name: orgx_act
tools.description: Run lifecycle, validation, completion, delete, dry-run, and proof actions.

tools.name: orgx_plan
tools.description: Start, resume, improve, edit, or complete tracked OrgX planning sessions.

tools.name: orgx_spawn
tools.description: Guard, classify, spawn, or hand off specialist OrgX agent work.

tools.name: orgx_decide
tools.description: Create, remember, list, approve, or reject durable OrgX decisions.

tools.name: orgx_submit_receipt
tools.description: Submit durable proof, attribution, quality, or outcome receipts.

tools.name: orgx_emit_activity
tools.description: Emit append-only execution telemetry without changing durable entity state.
